body:
Confirmed as promised: rebuilt the `with-claude-cli` image from `fa90d37` with **only** the one-line `AUTH_HOSTS` change, and the login flow works.

Before (stock `main`):

```
HTTP=502
{"error":{"message":"no authorization URL appeared: timed out; last output: … https://claude.com/cai/oauth/authorize?… "}}
```

After (`claude.com` added to `AUTH_HOSTS`, nothing else changed):

```
HTTP=200
{
  "login_id": "a27bff01-…",
  "status": "awaiting_code",
  "url": "https://claude.com/cai/oauth/authorize?code=true&client_id=…&code_challenge_method=S256&state=…",
  "session_expires_at": "2026-08-08T15:38:06Z"
}
```

Same binary, same image target, same CLI version — so the host list is the whole of it.

Worth noting what this also demonstrates: the surrounding #47 machinery is sound. The PTY capture, the idle-settled readiness wait, the session registry and the 15-minute `session_expires_at` all behave as designed; the single-host omission was the only thing preventing the flow from being reachable at all.
